svg.title: this, owner and delegate for a closure inside a closure inside a class
svg.desc: Three nested boxes: a Greenhouse instance, an outer closure defined in one of its methods, and an inner closure defined in the outer closure. For each closure the figure lists thisObject, owner and delegate, and the default lookup order for a name used in the inner closure.
svg.text: (thisObject of every closure created inside its methods)
owner = the Greenhouse instance (the object that encloses the closure)
delegate = the Greenhouse instance (defaults to owner; assignable)
def inner = { -> name } (created while outer runs)
thisObject = the Greenhouse instance (never a closure, however deep the nesting)
owner = the outer closure (the closure that directly encloses it)
delegate = the outer closure (defaults to owner; assignable)
Default OWNER_FIRST lookup of a bare name or call in inner
1 owner: the outer closure, which applies its own strategy to its own owner
(the Greenhouse) and then to its own delegate
2 delegate of inner: by default the outer closure again, so nothing new is found
DELEGATE_FIRST swaps steps 1 and 2; OWNER_ONLY, DELEGATE_ONLY and TO_SELF use one source.
